facts.fact: The NYC Small Business Services Hotline phone number is 888-SBS-4NYC (888-727-4692).
facts.quote: Have questions? Please call the NYC Small Business Services Hotline at 888-SBS-4NYC (888-727-4692)

facts.fact: The Shop Your City page lists 3 top ways to support neighborhood small businesses: shop in person, shop online, and buy a gift card.
facts.quote: Here are the top 3 ways you can support the small businesses that make our city a unique place to live

facts.fact: NYC Business Express Service Team (BEST) services are available in multiple languages.
facts.quote: Services are available in multiple languages.

facts.fact: The NYC Online Directory of Certified Businesses is a searchable list of M/WBE, LBE, and EBE certified businesses across the New York City area.
facts.quote: The Online Directory of Certified Businesses is a searchable list of M/WBE, LBE, and EBE certified businesses across the New York City area.
